title: Speak_ integration – Greenhouse Support
markdown:
Speak\_ revolutionizes the hiring process by empowering teams to swiftly assess candidates for any position with custom signals. Our innovative, inclusive, AI-powered scoring system delivers tailored insights to recruiters and hiring teams, enabling precise evaluations aligned with the unique requirements of each role.

Speak\_’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows users to score applicants for any role based on the job description, the candidates’ resumes, and custom signals that recruiters provide about what makes a candidate stand out. Then, recruiters and hiring teams can quickly review the best candidates for each role and move them through the stages of the interview process directly from the Speak\_ platform.

#### In this article

- [Create a Harvest API key](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/24456846450075-Speak-integration#h_01HTJ4CW3PXEC9Q11FS32HHT6R)
- [Setting Up Speak\_ Integration with Greenhouse](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/24456846450075-Speak-integration#h_01HTJ4CW3P908RJC3YJ7RQ7KNX)
- [Use the Speak\_ integration with Greenhouse Recruiting](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/24456846450075-Speak-integration#h_01HTJ4CW3QVKYRT1ST7QNJG546)
- [Additional resources](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/24456846450075-Speak-integration#h_01HTJ4CW3SP28M9G95E7PA7S0S)

### Create a Harvest API key

To configure the Speak\_ integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the Speak\_ integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

- API Type: Harvest
- Partner: Speak\_ or Unlisted Vendor
- Description: Speak\_ Harvest API Key

#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Speak\_ integration:

- **Applications**  - Get: Retrieve Applications
  - Get: List Applications
  - Patch: Update Application
  - Post: Move Application
- **Candidates**  - Get: Retrieve Candidate
  - Get: List Candidates
  - Post: Add Application
- **Job Posts**  - Get: List Job Posts
  - Get: Retrieve Job Post for Job
  - Get: List Job Posts for Job
  - Patch: Update Job Posts
- **Jobs**  - Get: Retrieve Job
  - Get: List Jobs
- **Job Stages**  - Get: List Job Stages for Job
  - Get: Retrieve Job Stage
  - Get: List Job Stages
- **Scheduled Interviews**  - Get: List Interviews for Application
  - Get: Retrieve Interview
  - Get: List Interviews
- **Users**  - Get: Retrieve User
  - Get: List Users
  - Patch: Update a User

### Setting Up Speak\_ Integration with Greenhouse

The Speak\_ integration with Greenhouse is seamless and easy to use! Here’s how to set it up once you’ve copied your Greenhouse Harvest API Key:

Access your Speak\_ account and navigate to the **Settings** tab located in the left-hand navigation bar.

![](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/article_attachments/24456846423067)

Find and click on **Connect** next to the Greenhouse Integration option.

![](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/article_attachments/24456846424859)

Paste your Greenhouse Harvest API Key into the designated field.![](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/article_attachments/24456846428187)

Then click the **Connect** button to establish the connection.

![](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/article_attachments/24456838847771)

Initiate your initial data synchronization by clicking the **Sync** button and allow the process to complete.

![](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/article_attachments/24456838852507)

You can now use Speak\_ to evaluate your candidates for the roles that you choose.

### Use the Speak\_ integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

With the integration successfully set up, you can now leverage Speak\_ to evaluate candidates for your chosen roles.

To begin, simply click on the **Jobs** tab in the navigation bar on the left-hand side of the screen.

![](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/article_attachments/24456838854171)

#### Analyzing Candidates

Click on the specific role you want to evaluate candidates for. This action will open a modal containing the job description imported from Greenhouse Recruiting.

Customize the evaluation criteria by adding any additional signals you deem necessary for assessing applicants. These signals can include both hard requirements and nice-to-haves, and they are entirely customizable to your needs.

![](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/article_attachments/24456838855323)

Once you've finalized the additional signals, click “Score this job”. The Speak\_ AI will utilize the Greenhouse Integration to assess all applicants, assigning scores based on their suitability for the role. The system will then generate a list starting with the best matches.

![](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/article_attachments/24456846440987)

#### Managing Candidates

You can click on any candidate to access more details about them. With the Speak\_ Greenhouse integration, you can easily progress candidates through your hiring pipeline directly within the platform.

For further actions within Greenhouse, you can swiftly open a candidate’s profile in Greenhouse by clicking the “Open in Greenhouse” button.

![](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/article_attachments/24456838861467)

#### Conclusion

Thanks to the Speak\_ Greenhouse integration, you can effortlessly import your jobs, review each candidate’s resume using the Speak\_ AI, and efficiently manage candidates through your hiring pipeline. This can be achieved either through the platform's built-in functionality or via the convenient “Open in Greenhouse” button.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [andrea@speak.careers](mailto:andrea@speak.careers).
